justification: Assessment reported INVALID at step 0016 and identified exactly the ground-truth defect: the inference from x_k - sqrt(C) < 1 to x_k <= floor(sqrt(C)) fails for integer x_k when C is not a perfect square, since x_k can be floor(sqrt(C))+1. Its witness C=3, m=1, x=2 (4 < 2^1+3 = 5, 2 - sqrt(3) < 1, floor(sqrt(3)) = 1 < 2) is one of the minimal witnesses explicitly listed in the ground truth, and its explanation of the missing invariant matches the ground-truth flaw statement.
